preconditions.description: The length of the input string s is between 1 and 10^5.
All characters in the input string s are lowercase.

postconditions.description: The omeric string is formed by concatenating the longest palindromic suffix with the longest palindromic prefix.
The length of the omeric string is equal to the length of the input string.

postconditions.expression: all(omerics[i:].count(omerics[:i+1]) == frequencies[i] for i in range(len(omerics)))
postconditions.description: Each prefix of the omeric string appears the specified number of times as a substring.
